description: Summary statistics and figure: conservation of the APOF RxxR convertase site, mature chain length and sequon load across mammals
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
q='(gene:APOF OR protein_name:"apolipoprotein F") AND taxonomy_id:40674'
d=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
  params=dict(query=q,format="json",size=200,fields="accession,organism_name,length,sequence"),timeout=90).json()
od=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e['primaryAccession'],org=e['organism']['scientificName'],
                      length=e['sequence']['length'],seq=e['sequence']['value']) for e in d['results']])
od=od[od.length.between(260,400)].drop_duplicates('org')
rows=[]
for _,r in od.iterrows():
    s=r.seq
    cand=[x for x in re.finditer(r'R..R',s) if 0.35<x.end()/len(s)<0.70]
    cut=cand[-1].end() if cand else None
    allseq=[x.start()+1 for x in re.finditer(r'(?=(N[^P][ST]))',s)]
    rows.append(dict(organism=r.org,length=r.length,cut=cut,
                     mature_len=(len(s)-cut) if cut else np.nan,
                     n_mat=len([p for p in allseq if cut and p>cut]) if cut else np.nan,
                     n_pro=len([p for p in allseq if cut and p<=cut]) if cut else np.nan))
M=pd.DataFrame(rows)
n=len(M); has=M.cut.notna()
print(f"Mammalian APOF entries analysed: {n}")
print(f"RxxR present in the 35-70% window: {has.sum()}/{n} ({100*has.mean():.0f}%)")
ml=M.mature_len.dropna()
print(f"Predicted mature length: median {ml.median():.0f} aa, IQR {ml.quantile(.25):.0f}-{ml.quantile(.75):.0f}, "
      f"{(ml.between(155,165)).sum()}/{len(ml)} within 155-165 aa (human = 162)")
print(f"Mature chain N-sequon count: mean {M.n_mat.mean():.2f}; >=1 sequon in {(M.n_mat>=1).sum()}/{int(has.sum())} "
      f"({100*(M.n_mat>=1).mean(skipna=True):.0f}%)")
print(f"Propeptide N-sequon count:   mean {M.n_pro.mean():.2f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4))
ax[0].hist(ml,bins=np.arange(100,210,5),color='#2a6f97',edgecolor='w')
ax[0].axvline(162,color='#c1121f',lw=2); ax[0].text(163,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*.9,'human 162 aa',color='#c1121f',fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("predicted mature chain length (aa)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("mammalian species")
ax[0].set_title("Mature chain length after the\nC-terminal RxxR convertase site")
ax[1].hist(M.length,bins=np.arange(260,405,10),color='#874c62',edgecolor='w')
ax[1].axvline(326,color='#c1121f',lw=2); ax[1].set_xlabel("precursor length (aa)"); ax[1].set_title("Precursor length varies\nwhile mature length is held")
vc_m=M.n_mat.value_counts().sort_index(); vc_p=M.n_pro.value_counts().sort_index()
w=0.38
ax[2].bar(vc_p.index-w/2,vc_p.values,w,label='propeptide region',color='#e09f3e')
ax[2].bar(vc_m.index+w/2,vc_m.values,w,label='mature chain',color='#2a6f97')
ax[2].set_xlabel("number of N-X-S/T sequons"); ax[2].set_ylabel("species"); ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_title("Sequon load by segment")
for a in ax: a.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.suptitle("APOF propeptide architecture across %d mammals (UniProt sequences, RxxR-anchored)"%n,y=1.03)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
M.to_csv('apof_mammal_architecture.csv',index=False)
